statement: file_id=BLD-00;file_class=BUILD;authority_level=4;governed_by=GOV-00;status=ACTIVE
violation: BLD-00 lacks the canonical FILE-META record or uses non-ACTIVE status without higher-authority direction.
verification: Verify the first BLD-00 record exactly matches the canonical metadata statement.

statement: BLD-00 owns implementation identity guidance derived from SRC-00 project identity, scope, non-goals, and project-level ADR framing.
violation: A BLD-00 record claims ownership outside implementation identity guidance.
verification: Classify each BLD-00 statement as implementation identity guidance or reject it.

statement: BLD-00 must not define canister authority, domain entity semantics, Transfer validation semantics, Transfer lifecycle semantics, idempotency semantics, ledger invariants, failure classes, read model semantics, upgrade semantics, API truth, or test body content.
violation: A BLD-00 record defines behavior owned by SRC-01 through SRC-10 or executable test bodies.
verification: Compare BLD-00 statements against SRC-INDEX responsibility routing and SRC-00 source-limit records.

statement: BLD-00 must not create code files, folder layout, module internals, deployment procedure, or framework-specific implementation steps.
violation: A BLD-00 record specifies file paths, module internals, deployment commands, framework procedures, or executable code structure.
verification: Scan BLD-00 statements for code path, folder layout, module, deployment, framework, or command-level instructions.

statement: BLD-00 must not create source truth, domain truth, invariant truth, lifecycle truth, failure-class truth, API truth, schema truth, or verification truth.
violation: A BLD-00 record states new controlling source semantics instead of translating upstream authority into implementation identity guidance.
verification: Trace each BLD-00 statement to upstream GOV, SRC-INDEX, SRC-00, or SRC-10 records and reject untraced source claims.

statement: BLD-00 is primarily controlled by SRC-00 for implementation identity, project scope, non-goals, and project-level ADR translation.
violation: A BLD-00 implementation identity record traces primarily to a file other than SRC-00.
verification: Check implementation identity, scope, non-goal, and ADR translation records for SRC-00 trace coverage.

statement: SRC-10 may affect BLD-00 only for proof, Definition of Done, risk, and falsifier routing.
violation: A BLD-00 record uses SRC-10 to define project identity, domain semantics, architecture semantics, or implementation procedure.
verification: Check all SRC-10 traces in BLD-00 for proof, DONE, risk, or falsifier routing purpose only.

statement: GOV-00 controls BLD-00 schema, authority, trace direction, scope tokens, class, type tokens, naming, and conflict handling.
violation: A BLD-00 record violates GOV-00 schema, authority, trace, naming, or conflict rules.
verification: Validate BLD-00 against GOV-00 schema, registry, authority, trace, and conflict records.

statement: BLD-INDEX routing context is required before BLD-00 can authorize downstream code generation or be treated as build-routing complete.
violation: BLD-00 is used for downstream generation when BLD-INDEX routing context is missing, invalid, or unresolved.
verification: Audit the generation context for BLD-INDEX and reject code generation if BLD-INDEX is absent or invalid.

statement: Every BLD-00 record must trace to exact upstream controlling record ids rather than file names alone.
violation: A BLD-00 record trace cites only a file name, source family, or narrative reference.
verification: Inspect each trace array for exact GOV, SRC-INDEX, SRC-00, or SRC-10 record ids.

statement: Implementation identity artifacts derived from BLD-00 must use the project name ICP Deterministic Ledger Kernel.
violation: A BLD-00-derived implementation identity artifact uses a different authoritative project name.
verification: Compare BLD-00-derived project name references against PROJECT-IDENTITY-001.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must frame the project as a transfer-only multi-canister correctness kernel on ICP.
violation: An implementation identity claim frames the project outside transfer-only ICP multi-canister correctness-kernel scope.
verification: Review BLD-00-derived descriptions for transfer-only, ICP, multi-canister, and correctness-kernel framing.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must frame the project as a correctness-preserving execution architecture rather than primarily a finance application.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity claim treats the project as primarily a finance application.
verification: Compare identity language against PROJECT-THESIS-001 and PROJECT-THESIS-002.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must preserve explicit authority-boundary framing.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity claim omits or weakens explicit authority-boundary framing.
verification: Check BLD-00-derived identity statements for explicit authority-boundary framing.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must preserve single local Ledger Core commit-path framing.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity claim omits, weakens, or replaces the single local Ledger Core commit-path framing.
verification: Check identity and ADR translation statements for single local Ledger Core commit-path framing.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must preserve idempotent, append-only, and upgrade-safe balance-mutation framing.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity claim removes idempotent, append-only, or upgrade-safe balance-mutation framing.
verification: Check identity statements against idempotent, append-only, and upgrade-safe balance-mutation records.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must treat the MVP as a bounded correctness kernel.
violation: A BLD-00-derived scope claim treats the MVP as unbounded, product-complete, or outside correctness-kernel scope.
verification: Compare MVP scope claims against PROJECT-SCOPE-001.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must restrict MVP runtime operation scope to the Transfer operation family.
violation: A BLD-00-derived scope claim accepts a non-Transfer operation family as MVP runtime scope.
verification: Inspect operation-scope statements for Transfer-only MVP scope.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must require later active source authority before any non-Transfer operation family is introduced.
violation: A BLD-00-derived scope claim authorizes Deposit, Withdrawal, or another non-Transfer operation family without later active source authority.
verification: Check non-Transfer operation claims for later active source authority trace.

statement: Project-level ADR translation in BLD-00 must preserve Ledger Core ownership of authoritative MVP journal and balance mutation.
violation: A BLD-00-derived ADR translation assigns authoritative MVP journal or balance mutation outside Ledger Core.
verification: Compare project-level ADR translation against ADR-001, ADR-007, and ADR-008.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not require a separate Journal Canister for MVP correctness.
violation: A BLD-00-derived ADR translation requires a separate Journal Canister for MVP correctness.
verification: Check ADR translation statements for separate Journal Canister requirements.

statement: Target stack guidance at BLD-00 must remain subordinate to project identity, Transfer-only scope, and source authority boundaries.
violation: A BLD-00-derived target stack claim overrides project identity, expands MVP scope, or weakens source authority boundaries.
verification: Check target stack claims against SRC-00 identity, scope, non-goal, and authority records.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not infer project identity or scope from code, tests, README content, runtime behavior, or chat history.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity or scope claim uses code, tests, README content, runtime behavior, or chat history as controlling authority.
verification: Audit identity and scope trace paths for GOV, SRC-INDEX, SRC-00, and applicable SRC-10 authority records only.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not frame the project as a wallet application.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity, scope, README, report, or implementation-planning claim frames the project as a wallet application.
verification: Check BLD-00-derived artifacts for wallet application framing and compare against PROJECT-NONGOAL-001.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not frame the project as a DeFi protocol.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity, scope, README, report, or implementation-planning claim frames the project as a DeFi protocol.
verification: Check BLD-00-derived artifacts for DeFi protocol framing and compare against PROJECT-NONGOAL-002.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not frame the project as a token standard implementation.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity, scope, README, report, or implementation-planning claim frames the project as a token standard implementation.
verification: Check BLD-00-derived artifacts for token standard implementation framing and compare against PROJECT-NONGOAL-003.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not frame the project as a replacement for the ICP Ledger.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity, scope, README, report, or implementation-planning claim frames the project as a replacement for the ICP Ledger.
verification: Check BLD-00-derived artifacts for replacement for the ICP Ledger framing and compare against PROJECT-NONGOAL-004.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not frame the project as a replacement for ICRC standards.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity, scope, README, report, or implementation-planning claim frames the project as a replacement for ICRC standards.
verification: Check BLD-00-derived artifacts for replacement for ICRC standards framing and compare against PROJECT-NONGOAL-005.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not frame the project as a general accounting system.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity, scope, README, report, or implementation-planning claim frames the project as a general accounting system.
verification: Check BLD-00-derived artifacts for general accounting system framing and compare against PROJECT-NONGOAL-006.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not frame the project as a production banking ledger.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity, scope, README, report, or implementation-planning claim frames the project as a production banking ledger.
verification: Check BLD-00-derived artifacts for production banking ledger framing and compare against PROJECT-NONGOAL-007.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not frame the project as a multi-operation settlement system.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity, scope, README, report, or implementation-planning claim frames the project as a multi-operation settlement system.
verification: Check BLD-00-derived artifacts for multi-operation settlement system framing and compare against PROJECT-NONGOAL-008.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not frame the project as a UI-first project.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity, scope, README, report, or implementation-planning claim frames the project as a UI-first project.
verification: Check BLD-00-derived artifacts for UI-first project framing and compare against PROJECT-NONGOAL-009.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not frame the project as a performance benchmark.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity, scope, README, report, or implementation-planning claim frames the project as a performance benchmark.
verification: Check BLD-00-derived artifacts for performance benchmark framing and compare against PROJECT-NONGOAL-010.

statement: Implementation identity guidance must not frame the project as a market-ready financial product.
violation: A BLD-00-derived identity, scope, README, report, or implementation-planning claim frames the project as a market-ready financial product.
verification: Check BLD-00-derived artifacts for market-ready financial product framing and compare against PROJECT-NONGOAL-011.

statement: BLD-00 cannot authorize downstream code generation unless BLD-INDEX is valid and available as build-routing context.
violation: Downstream code generation proceeds from BLD-00 without valid BLD-INDEX routing context.
verification: Verify BLD-INDEX availability and validity before using BLD-00 for code generation.

statement: BLD-00 cannot authorize downstream code generation unless BLD-00 passes schema, trace, authority, and role-boundary validation.
violation: Downstream code generation proceeds from invalid or unvalidated BLD-00 records.
verification: Run BLD-00 validation before code generation and reject invalid records.

statement: BLD-00 cannot authorize downstream code generation unless every BLD-00 record traces to controlling GOV, SRC-INDEX, SRC-00, SRC-10, or BLD-INDEX authority.
violation: A BLD-00 record without controlling upstream trace is used for downstream generation.
verification: Inspect every BLD-00 trace array for exact upstream controlling record ids.

statement: BLD-00 cannot authorize downstream code generation from any record that creates source truth.
violation: A source-truth-creating BLD-00 record is used to guide implementation.
verification: Classify each BLD-00 record as source-truth-creating or build-identity guidance before code generation.

statement: BLD-00 cannot authorize downstream code generation that expands MVP runtime scope beyond Transfer.
violation: Code generation accepts Deposit, Withdrawal, or another non-Transfer operation family as MVP runtime scope.
verification: Check generated scope plans and operation surfaces for Transfer-only MVP scope.

statement: BLD-00 cannot introduce implementation authority for BLD-01 through BLD-10.
violation: A BLD-00 record defines responsibilities, routing, or implementation constraints owned by BLD-01 through BLD-10.
verification: Inspect BLD-00 statements for claims that assign or define other BLD file responsibilities.

statement: BLD-00 code-generation eligibility is limited to project identity layer guidance and must not be used as complete implementation procedure.
violation: BLD-00 is treated as sufficient authority for full code generation, module design, deployment, or framework procedure.
verification: Check generation prompts for reliance on BLD-00 beyond project identity layer guidance.

statement: BLD-00 must use valid JSONL schema with exactly the required fields in GOV-00 field order.
violation: A BLD-00 line is invalid JSON, contains multiple objects, omits a required field, adds a field, or changes field order.
verification: Run strict JSONL parse and fixed-field-order validation on every non-empty line.

statement: BLD-00 must contain exactly one FILE-META record.
violation: BLD-00 contains zero or more than one FILE-META record.
verification: Count records whose statement matches the canonical FILE-META statement format.

statement: Every BLD-00 record must trace to controlling GOV, SRC-INDEX, SRC-00, SRC-10, or BLD-INDEX authority.
violation: A BLD-00 record has an empty trace array, unresolved trace id, or trace outside permitted upstream authority.
verification: Resolve each trace id against upstream governed records and reject empty or unresolved trace arrays.

statement: Every BLD-00 implementation identity instruction must trace to SRC-00 authority.
violation: A BLD-00 implementation identity instruction lacks SRC-00 trace coverage.
verification: Filter BLD-00 identity, scope, non-goal, and ADR translation records and verify SRC-00 trace coverage.

statement: Every BLD-00 proof, Definition of Done, risk, or falsifier routing instruction must trace to SRC-10 where applicable.
violation: A BLD-00 proof, DONE, risk, or falsifier routing instruction lacks SRC-10 trace coverage.
verification: Filter BLD-00 records mentioning proof, DONE, risk, or falsifier routing and verify SRC-10 trace coverage.

statement: No BLD-00 record may create new source truth.
violation: A BLD-00 record defines new domain, invariant, lifecycle, failure, API, schema, or verification truth.
verification: Classify each BLD-00 statement as source truth or build identity guidance and reject source-truth records.

statement: No BLD-00 record may weaken GOV-00, SRC-INDEX, SRC-00, SRC-10, or BLD-INDEX authority.
violation: A BLD-00 record overrides, narrows, removes, or downgrades controlling upstream authority.
verification: Compare BLD-00 statements against controlling upstream records for contradiction or weakening.

statement: No BLD-00 record may define behavior owned by BLD-01 through BLD-10.
violation: A BLD-00 record defines another BLD file responsibility, routing rule, code structure, implementation procedure, or validation domain.
verification: Inspect BLD-00 statements for BLD-01 through BLD-10 responsibility definitions.

statement: Every BLD-00 record must have file=BLD-00, class=BUILD, authority_level=4, authorized type token, and authorized scope tokens.
violation: A BLD-00 record uses a wrong file, class, authority level, type token, or scope token.
verification: Validate file, class, authority_level, type, and scope fields against GOV-00 registries.

statement: If GOV-00 conflicts with BLD-00, GOV-00 controls and dependent generation must stop.
violation: A GOV-00 versus BLD-00 conflict is silently merged or resolved in favor of BLD-00.
verification: Detect contradictions between BLD-00 and GOV-00 and verify stop-and-report handling.

statement: If SRC-00 conflicts with BLD-00 identity, scope, non-goal, or project-level ADR translation, SRC-00 controls and dependent generation must stop.
violation: A SRC-00 versus BLD-00 conflict is silently merged or resolved in favor of BLD-00.
verification: Compare BLD-00 identity, scope, non-goal, and ADR records against SRC-00 records.

statement: If SRC-10 conflicts with BLD-00 proof, risk, DONE, or falsifier routing, SRC-10 controls and dependent generation must stop.
violation: A SRC-10 proof, risk, DONE, or falsifier conflict is silently merged or resolved in favor of BLD-00.
verification: Compare BLD-00 proof, risk, DONE, and falsifier routing statements against SRC-10 records.

statement: If BLD-INDEX routing conflicts with BLD-00 routing, BLD-INDEX routing controls within index authority and dependent generation must stop until resolved.
violation: A BLD-INDEX versus BLD-00 routing conflict is ignored or resolved in favor of BLD-00 routing.
verification: Compare BLD-00 routing claims against BLD-INDEX routing context and GOV-00 index-authority limits.

statement: A BLD-00 record without controlling source trace must stop downstream generation.
violation: A BLD-00 record with empty, unresolved, or non-controlling trace is used downstream.
verification: Resolve trace arrays for every BLD-00 record before downstream generation.

statement: A BLD-00 attempt to define another BLD file responsibility must stop downstream generation.
violation: BLD-00 defines responsibilities, validation domains, or implementation authority for BLD-01 through BLD-10.
verification: Scan BLD-00 for responsibility claims naming BLD-01 through BLD-10.

statement: A BLD-00 attempt to expand MVP runtime scope beyond Transfer must stop downstream generation; SRC-10 falsifier and risk trace ids support stop-routing evidence only and do not define scope authority.
violation: BLD-00 authorizes Deposit, Withdrawal, or another non-Transfer operation family as MVP runtime scope.
verification: Check BLD-00 operation-scope claims against Transfer-only SRC-00 records, and treat SRC-10 falsifier and risk traces as stop-routing evidence only.

statement: A BLD-00 attempt to create code structure, folder layout, module internals, deployment procedure, or framework-specific steps must stop downstream generation.
violation: BLD-00 specifies code structure, folder layout, module internals, deployment procedure, or framework-specific steps.
verification: Scan BLD-00 for file paths, module declarations, deployment steps, commands, framework names, or executable procedures.

statement: All unresolved BLD-00 conflicts must stop downstream generation and escalate to GOV-00 authority rules.
violation: An unresolved BLD-00 conflict is ignored, merged, or allowed to guide downstream generation.
verification: Confirm every unresolved BLD-00 conflict maps to stop-and-report handling under GOV-00 conflict rules.
